messages:
alex: planning a staggered router rebalance tonight during the 02:00-03:00 UTC quiet hour to even out edge-pool utilization. low-risk plan: incremental weight adjustments across regions, 5% steps every 3m with health checks in between. want quick ack and any objections.

maya: sounds good. which pools are we touching? any KV/cache warmup concerns?

alex: touching eu-west-edge, us-central-edge primarily. will avoid touching ap-south for now. KV cache should be fine — we’ll do a short priming walk after each 25% change to warm popular prefixes.

jordan: please pin the router binary to v1.12.3 for the window. last time an unpinned swap caused a config drift.

lia: ack on pin. also add a temporary rule to route 0.1% test traffic to a canary host to detect config regressions.

alex: good call — will add 0.1% canary. full plan (short):
```
1) deploy-bot schedule at 02:00 UTC
2) pin router -> v1.12.3 across control-plane for window
3) step weights: +5% every 3m up to target, with 90s health check after each step
4) after each 25% aggregate movement, run KV prefix priming job (script below)
5) abort if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increases by >20%
6) rollback: routerctl set-weights --file rollback-weights.json OR deploy-bot abort-run <run_id>
```

alex: KV priming script:
```bash
# quick priming run for top prefixes
python tools/kv_prime.py --pool eu-west-edge --topk 500 --concurrency 8
```

maya: looks solid. who will own the manual abort if SLOs degrade?

alex: @sre-oncall will be primary. @jordan in backup. I'll monitor dashboards and be on-call in the thread.

sre-oncall: I’ll be around 01:45-03:30 UTC. set alerts: pager if 5xx spike or p95 crosses thresholds. I’ll take manual abort.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rebalance run created: run_id=rb-20260323-42, window=02:00-03:00 UTC, steps=5pct/3m, pinned_version=v1.12.3

lia: can we add a quick smoke check after each step that hits the topo endpoint and validates 200s? tiny script:
```bash
curl -sS https://topo.internal/health | jq '.status=="ok"'
```

alex: yes — will add smoke check. also I'll post rollback weights to the playbook in case we need immediate set-weights.

jordan: note: do not exceed pool-weight target >70% for eu-west-edge, keep parity with us-central. otherwise session affinity thrash.

maya: +1 on session affinity note. can the router keep sticky TTL=12h during the window?

alex: requesting TTL bump for window. ops: please confirm if sticky TTL change needs infra approval.

sre-oncall: infra ok from my side for short TTL bump. just log the change.

deploy-bot: run rb-20260323-42: started (02:00:00 UTC). stepping weights +5% to eu-west-edge (current->5%).

alex: step1 in progress. watching error rates and p95.

lia: step1 smoke check: OK :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: run rb-20260323-42: step1 health checks passed. proceeding to next step in 3m.

alex: step2 +5% -> 10%. priming job kicked.

jordan: priming run looked fine, no KV thrash.

maya: latency stable. no 5xx spike. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: run rb-20260323-42: step3 +5% -> 15%. smoke check failed on one probe (topo returned 502).

alex: observed the 502. pausing run. manual verification happening.

sre-oncall: investigating. checking backend pool health and LB backend.

jordan: I see a transient 502 on one eu-west node, looks like a JVM OOM on one host. it's being cordoned.

alex: decision: abort further steps, roll back to last known-good weights (pre-change). @deploy-bot please run rollback now.

deploy-bot: run rb-20260323-42: abort acknowledged. initiating rollback to weights: {"eu-west-edge": 7, "us-central-edge": 88, "others": 5} 

lia: rollback started. will monitor smoke checks.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. smoke checks all green. run rb-20260323-42: status=aborted_and_rolled_back

alex: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) root-cause JVM OOM on eu-west host — infra to open ticket and patch, 2) rehearse with a smaller 2% step plan for next window, 3) ensure the rollout playbook contains explicit failure thresholds and the rollback payload (I’ll update it).

sre-oncall: opening INC-3142 for the OOM and will add remediation plan.

jordan: also recommend adding a canary that checks JVM heap metrics before traffic steps.

maya: noted. great catch everyone. closing the window.

alex: closing thread. plan follow-up doc and schedule another small-window test next Tue 02:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
